bind.title: How TcpListener::bind works
bind.description: Starts listening for TCP connections on an address.

slides.caption: Port 0 lets the OS choose a free port.
Err if the port is already in use (AddrInUse).

local_addr.title: How TcpListener::local_addr works
local_addr.description: The address and port the listener is bound to.

slides.caption: With port 0, this tells you which port the OS picked.
Tests use this to start servers on free ports.

accept.title: How TcpListener::accept works
accept.description: Waits for the next client and returns a stream to talk to it.

slides.caption: accept returns its stream and address.

incoming.title: How TcpListener::incoming works
incoming.description: An endless iterator of incoming connections.

slides.caption: Handle it, then wait for the next.
Spawn a thread per client, or use async.

connect.title: How TcpStream::connect works
connect.description: Opens a TCP connection to a server.

slides.caption: The stream implements Read and Write.

peer_addr.title: How TcpStream::peer_addr works
peer_addr.description: The address of the other end.

slides.caption: On the client, it is the server's address.

tcp_stream-local_addr.title: How TcpStream::local_addr works
tcp_stream-local_addr.description: The address of this end of the connection.

slides.caption: Clients get a random local port.
It equals the server's peer_addr for this stream.

note.text: result: same as server sees: true

shutdown.title: How TcpStream::shutdown works
shutdown.description: Closes the reading, writing or both halves of a connection.

slides.caption: The other side reads 0 bytes (end of file) after your last data.
Shut down writing: the server reaches EOF.

set_nodelay.title: How TcpStream::set_nodelay works
set_nodelay.description: Turns off Nagle's algorithm so small writes are sent immediately.

slides.caption: By default TCP may hold small packets briefly to combine them.
Good for games and chat; not needed for bulk transfers.

set_read_timeout.title: How TcpStream::set_read_timeout works
set_read_timeout.description: Makes reads fail instead of waiting forever.

slides.caption: The read gives up with an error.
The error kind differs between platforms.

peek.title: How TcpStream::peek works
peek.description: Reads incoming data without removing it from the queue.

slides.caption: The next read returns the same bytes again.
Useful for sniffing a protocol header.

try_clone.title: How TcpStream::try_clone works
try_clone.description: A second handle to the same connection.

slides.caption: Common: one thread reads while another writes.
Write through one, the data still arrives.
Both handles share the same connection.

udp-bind.title: How UdpSocket::bind works
udp-bind.description: Opens a UDP socket on an address.

slides.caption: UDP sends independent packets (datagrams); there is no connection.

send_to.title: How UdpSocket::send_to works
send_to.description: Sends one datagram to an address.

slides.caption: Delivery is not guaranteed in general; on localhost it practically always works.
Each send is one separate packet.

recv_from.title: How UdpSocket::recv_from works
recv_from.description: Waits for one datagram and tells who sent it.

slides.caption: A too-small buffer cuts the datagram off.

udp-local_addr.title: How UdpSocket::local_addr works
udp-local_addr.description: The address the socket is bound to.

slides.caption: Tells you which port the OS picked.
Share it with the peer so it can reply.

udp-connect.title: How UdpSocket::connect works
udp-connect.description: Sets a default peer, so send/recv can be used without addresses.

slides.caption: Packets from other addresses are then ignored.
No handshake happens: it is still UDP.

send.title: How UdpSocket::send works
send.description: Sends a datagram to the connected peer.

slides.caption: Fails if connect() was never called.

recv.title: How UdpSocket::recv works
recv.description: Receives a datagram from the connected peer.

slides.caption: Only accepts packets from the connected peer.

peek_from.title: How UdpSocket::peek_from works
peek_from.description: Looks at the next datagram without removing it.

o0t.text: peek and recv see the same

slides.caption: The next recv returns the same packet.

udp-peek.title: How UdpSocket::peek works
udp-peek.description: Looks at the next datagram from the connected peer without removing it.

slides.caption: Useful to check a packet type before reading it.
Err if connect was never called.
UDP "connections" are just a remembered address.

udp-set_read_timeout.title: How UdpSocket::set_read_timeout works
udp-set_read_timeout.description: Makes recv fail instead of waiting forever.

slides.caption: Essential for UDP, where a reply may never come.

read_timeout.title: How UdpSocket::read_timeout works
read_timeout.description: The current read timeout, if any.

slides.caption: write_timeout works the same for sends.

set_ttl.title: How UdpSocket::set_ttl works
set_ttl.description: Sets how many network hops a packet may travel.

slides.caption: Each router decreases it; at 0 the packet is dropped.
traceroute works by raising the TTL step by step.

udp-try_clone.title: How UdpSocket::try_clone works
udp-try_clone.description: A second handle to the same socket.

slides.caption: Both handles use the same port.
Typical: one thread receives, another sends.

set_nonblocking.title: How UdpSocket::set_nonblocking works
set_nonblocking.description: Makes recv return at once (WouldBlock) when nothing is waiting.

slides.caption: async runtimes use this under the hood.

take_error.title: How UdpSocket::take_error works
take_error.description: Takes the socket's pending error, if any.

slides.caption: Some errors arrive asynchronously and are stored on the socket.

set_multicast_ttl_v4.title: How UdpSocket::set_multicast_ttl_v4 works
set_multicast_ttl_v4.description: How far IPv4 multicast packets may travel.

slides.caption: The default 1 keeps multicast on the local network.
Raise it carefully: multicast can flood networks.

set_multicast_loop_v4.title: How UdpSocket::set_multicast_loop_v4 works
set_multicast_loop_v4.description: Whether your own multicast packets come back to you.

slides.caption: The v6 version works the same.

connect_timeout.title: How TcpStream::connect_timeout works
connect_timeout.description: Connects, but gives up after a time limit.

slides.caption: Without it, connecting to a dead host can hang for a long time.
Takes a resolved SocketAddr, not a host name.
false means small writes may be combined.

tcp_stream-read_timeout.title: How TcpStream::read_timeout works
tcp_stream-read_timeout.description: The current read timeout, if any.

set_write_timeout.title: How TcpStream::set_write_timeout works
set_write_timeout.description: Makes writes fail instead of waiting forever when the peer stops reading.

slides.caption: Writes block when the peer's buffer is full.

tcp_stream-set_ttl.title: How TcpStream::set_ttl works
tcp_stream-set_ttl.description: Sets the time-to-live of packets on this connection.

tcp_stream-set_nonblocking.title: How TcpStream::set_nonblocking works
tcp_stream-set_nonblocking.description: Makes reads and writes return WouldBlock instead of waiting.

slides.caption: The basis of hand-written polling loops.
async runtimes do this for you.

tcp_stream-take_error.title: How TcpStream::take_error works
tcp_stream-take_error.description: Takes the connection's pending error, if any.

slides.caption: Used after non-blocking connects to see if they failed.

tcp_listener-set_nonblocking.title: How TcpListener::set_nonblocking works
tcp_listener-set_nonblocking.description: Makes accept return WouldBlock when no client is waiting.

slides.caption: Lets one thread check for clients between other work.
Accepted streams start in blocking mode again.

tcp_listener-set_ttl.title: How TcpListener::set_ttl works
tcp_listener-set_ttl.description: Sets the TTL for connections accepted by this listener.

tcp_listener-try_clone.title: How TcpListener::try_clone works
tcp_listener-try_clone.description: A second handle to the same listening socket.

slides.caption: Several threads can accept from the same port.
Each client is accepted by exactly one of them.

tcp_listener-take_error.title: How TcpListener::take_error works
tcp_listener-take_error.description: Takes the listener's pending error, if any.

ttl.title: How UdpSocket::ttl works
ttl.description: The IP time-to-live used for packets sent from this socket.

slides.caption: Each router lowers the TTL by one; at 0 the packet is dropped.

write_timeout.title: How UdpSocket::write_timeout works
write_timeout.description: How long send may block before giving up; None means forever.

slides.caption: A new socket has no timeout.

udp-set_write_timeout.title: How UdpSocket::set_write_timeout works
udp-set_write_timeout.description: Limits how long send may block.

slides.caption: Some(Duration::ZERO) is an error; None removes the limit.
Blocked sends then fail with WouldBlock or TimedOut.

broadcast.title: How UdpSocket::broadcast works
broadcast.description: Whether the socket may send to broadcast addresses.

slides.caption: Off by default to avoid flooding a network by accident.

multicast_ttl_v4.title: How UdpSocket::multicast_ttl_v4 works
multicast_ttl_v4.description: The TTL for IPv4 multicast packets.

slides.caption: The default of 1 keeps multicast on the local network.

multicast_loop_v4.title: How UdpSocket::multicast_loop_v4 works
multicast_loop_v4.description: Whether IPv4 multicast you send also comes back to your own host.

slides.caption: Turn it off to ignore your own messages.

multicast_loop_v6.title: How UdpSocket::multicast_loop_v6 works
multicast_loop_v6.description: Whether IPv6 multicast you send also comes back to your own host.

set_multicast_loop_v6.title: How UdpSocket::set_multicast_loop_v6 works
set_multicast_loop_v6.description: Turns looping back of your own IPv6 multicast on or off.

join_multicast_v4.title: How UdpSocket::join_multicast_v4 works
join_multicast_v4.description: Subscribes the socket to an IPv4 multicast group.

slides.caption: The second address picks the interface; UNSPECIFIED lets the OS choose.
Packets to it now arrive here.

leave_multicast_v4.title: How UdpSocket::leave_multicast_v4 works
leave_multicast_v4.description: Unsubscribes from an IPv4 multicast group.

slides.caption: Leaving a group you never joined is an error.

join_multicast_v6.title: How UdpSocket::join_multicast_v6 works
join_multicast_v6.description: Subscribes to an IPv6 multicast group on an interface index.

leave_multicast_v6.title: How UdpSocket::leave_multicast_v6 works
leave_multicast_v6.description: Unsubscribes from an IPv6 multicast group.

slides.caption: Use the same interface index as for joining.

tcp_listener-ttl.title: How TcpListener::ttl works
tcp_listener-ttl.description: The IP time-to-live for connections accepted by this listener.

tcp_stream-ttl.title: How TcpStream::ttl works
tcp_stream-ttl.description: The IP time-to-live of this connection's packets.

slides.caption: Each router lowers it by one.

tcp_stream-write_timeout.title: How TcpStream::write_timeout works
tcp_stream-write_timeout.description: How long a write may block; None means forever.
